quote: rated this game a 2 because it runs so poorly on the switch. Whoever did the port to this game completely broke it. I never once had any of these issues on the xbox back compatibility, or on original hardware for this game. The incompetence to make old games run on systems is absolutely appalling. The game is from 2004 how does it not run perfect for the switch?. Aspyr should be ashamed of their work on this game.
